dependencies.required_evidence: Exact 25,832-byte phase-1 source layout with SHA-256 b8441e585391bf3d631230d96413f1cc8f00ac9bcb7cd2daa8a2fb9e1e816c01.

independent_derivation.calculation_rule: For every positive-byte tensor, leaves=ceil(logical_bytes/4096), maximum_tree_nodes=2*leaves-1, and digest storage is 32 bytes per node; totals sum expanded tensor families rather than treating a partition as one tensor.

scientific_boundary.completed: Exact typed layout and grouped source-write surface for Byte-LSTM dynamic, parameters, optimizer, ordinary tape, and dormant v4 midpoint state.
scientific_boundary.not_completed: The external predictor partition, physical-segment visitor implementation, soft-dirty calibration, independent parser, v5 source, and every runtime gate.
scientific_boundary.why_phase1_is_not_activation: The v1 ABI requires all six partitions. A complete five-partition layout cannot substitute for missing mixers, SSE, context tables, small FXCM state, bit head, frontend, and reversible transform state.

activation_requirements: An independent future auditor must reproduce this review from the exact bound source rather than trusting the stored true values.
The external predictor typed map and physical-segment coverage must close before a six-partition source-completeness receipt can exist.
Soft-dirty calibration and mutation controls must pass before incremental roots can be interpreted.
Q1-v3 qualification, v4 source materialization, and the absence of the full-1G lease remain mandatory before v5 source work.
claim_boundary: This review checks JSON structure and layout arithmetic only; it is not a compiler, AST completeness, runtime, parser, mutation, synchronization, compression, inverse, resource, package, or Hutter result.
The explicit open external partition prevents accidental promotion of phase 1 as complete observability.
No score or compression credit is granted.
